EGW35CA2R220	CodeError: 2 blocks of 108 mm with 10 mm gaps do not fit on a 220 mm rail
EGH20CB	CodeError: EGH is mounted from the top only: EGH20CA (the catalogue lists EGH-SA / EGH-CA)
EGR20T640	NotModelled: EGR rail mounted from the bottom (T) is valid HIWIN grammar, but the catalogue prints no tapped-hole dimensions for it (tables (1)-(3) on p.57-59 are the top-mounted R rail), so it is not drawn
EGR15R5000	CodeError: rail length 5000 mm above the maximum 4000 mm
EGR25R60	CodeError: rail length 60 mm below the catalogue minimum 100 mm (Table 2-2-1)
EGW20SA1R500	CodeError: rail length 500 leaves end distance 40.00 mm, above P/2 = 30 mm (unstable rail end, p.56)
EGW20SAM	CodeError: stainless steel (M) exists for EG15C only (model number note 4, p.45)
EGW25CAZB	CodeError: 'EGW25CAZB': expected a set EG<H|W><size><C|S><A|B><n>R<length>[Z0|ZA|ZB][C|H|P], e.g. EGH20CA2R1000ZAH, a rail EGR<size>R<length>, e.g. EGR25R1600, or a block EGW25CA
EGW25CA2R640ZAP+DD	NotModelled: dust-protection codes ZZ, DD and KK are valid HIWIN grammar; they change the overall block length (p.53), which is not drawn: leave the option out for the standard end seal and bottom seal length
